name: agentlint-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentlint/core && npm run build -w agentlint && npm run build -w @agentlint/web && npm run build -w agentlint-vscode
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agentlint/core && npm run build -w @agentlint/core && npm exec -- vitest run apps/web/test
scripts.agentlint: npm run build -w @agentlint/core && npm run dev -w agentlint --
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @agentlint/core && npm run build -w @agentlint/web
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build -w @agentlint/core && npm run build -w agentlint-vscode
scripts.preview: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @agentlint/web
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && npm run package -w agentlint-vscode
scripts.release:bundle: npm run test:all && npm run package:vscode && node scripts/release-check.mjs && node scripts/create-release-bundle.mjs

description: Lint, validate and optimize instructions for AI coding agents
